profile.geoLocationName: Salt Lake City, Utah, United States

positions.title: Living Being
positions.description:
Grew up exploring the mountains of Idaho at a very young age. Skiing since age 4. Followed my Father mountaineering and cragging through The Sawtooths, White Clouds, Bitterroots and Pioneers; Hiked the Mis-i-wa trail at 13 (50 + miles); Heli-skied the Bugaboos at 14. Eagle Scout. Am an experienced Woodsman and have and well-rounded outdoor and survival skills. Intermediate oarsman and kayaking skills. 

Around 18 start technical rock climbing. Never pursued into high numbers, but realized 5.11 sport and 5.10 tradition level climbing. Highlights include: 
City of Rocks, Idaho – Lowe Route (Eberhorn Twin Sister when it wasn’t illegal), Bloody Fingers, Cyclops, Pretzel Logic, Skyline, She’s The Bosch, Tribal Boundaries, City Girls…
Wasatch – The Fin Arête, The Thumb S-Direct, Arm N’ Hammer, and many Little Cottonwood classics as well as Big Cottonwood sandbags.
Redrocks, NV – The doable clip-ups at The Gallery, Corridor and surrounding environs; as well as Beulah’s Book, The Solar Slab and Crimson Chrysalis.

Recently in life, my children have become of age where they both climb on their own. It has become much motivation for me to “get off the couch” and show them what I can, while I still can. Meanwhile I will belay/clean whatever they want to rope-gun.

Bucket List
•	Grand Teton via Gold Face variation
•	Climb 5.11a sport again (outside!)
•	El Cap? Too over-hyped, but definitely a multi-day big wall.
•	Do a “Walden” experience, but for real.
•	The “Haute Route” before its gone
•	Trek Hymilayan Langtang region and build something

positions.title: Principle
positions.description:
Hardware/Software research, feasibility, development and testing.
Multi-lingual coder. Experienced since the first release of VS 2000, ASP.NET and beyond.
-Currently active in Visual Studio (VS) 2017/2019, C#, ASP.NET Core and associated Core development technologies: MVC, Razor, EF, Owin, Kestrel, IIS Integration…  
-Associated client-side technology and “Frameworks”: HTML5, Javascript, Web APIs, JQuery, KnockoutJS, Node.js, NPM, Ruby, SASS, Grunt…
-Build and manage Windows Server 2012 R2 VPS w/ SQL Server 2017 Express & SSMS 2017, IIS 10, SSL, Kestrel & ASP.NET Core 2.0.x Hosting, Web Deploy Services
-See https://defaultwebsite.net for a portal to notes, demos and code samples illustrating technical skillsets and current activities. Don’t miss the Sandpit live demos!!!
-Registered ESRI Developer. Live ArcGIS Online. Check defaultwebsite.net for updated live GIS demos.
-Maintain and manage development operations using VS Team Foundation Services (Azure DevOps), mirrored at GitHub https://github.com/SwartHack

positions.title: Mobile Development Manager
positions.description:
Returned to the USDA Forest Service engineering team as Mobile Team tech lead for the design, development and support of existing field based mobile applications. Participating in the definition of a new architecture and approach for mobile application development using latest mobile platforms and technologies.

-Actively assessed and addressed existing issues regarding current mobile application development and pursued the necessary relationships with the BAO and ADMO.
-Made a distinct effort to resolve and address outstanding Mobile technological issues.
-Participated in agency wide assessment of migrating to market salient mobile platform: Android, iPhone, Windows Phone.

positions.title: Senior GIS Developer
positions.description:
Involved in ground-up engineering/development of next generation technology and applications to provide/analyze data acquired in in-theater surveillance/reconnaissance activities. Specialized in the integration of GIS technologies into video capture approaches to provide georeferenced video capabilities and analysis. Including:

-Design and development of an nth tier Service Oriented Architecture (SOA) utilizing Windows Communication Foundation (WCF) services.
-Implementation of key required GIS functionality using ThinkGeo Mapsuite SDK software.
-Integration of GIS application functionality into service oriented architecture (SOA).
-Real time enhancement and maintenance of web based application for active in-theater client.
-Real time support of in-theater on-the-ground systems.
-Research and Development of custom plug-in for National Geospatial Information Agency (NGA) RaptorX special operations application

positions.title: Contractor for GIS Development and Services
positions.description: Nationally recruited as GIS Developer/Mobile Team Lead to join the USDA Forest Service engineering team to help continued development of systems that upwardly report to US Congress the inventory and maintenance of physical assets of the national forests. Provided support and development for Geographic Information Systems (GIS). Team lead for design, development and support of field-based mobile applications. Participated in the engineering department’s INFRA/I-Web and NRM projects.

positions.title: Development Lead/Senior Analyst
positions.description: Researched and developed new technologies for Web based Computer Telephony Integration (CTI). Implemented new CTI technologies and ASP/ASP.NET to replace old Informix ASCII based 4gl interfaces. Develop General Dialer/Switch maintenance and administration: Nobles, Lucent G3. Research and evaluate existing and emerging technologies (ASP.NET) to replace legacy systems. Train programming staff in the nature and development of new technologies and concepts.

positions.title: Development Practice Lead/Senior Consultant
positions.description:
Managed local office’s development practice and its 15-30 developers. Performed applicant technical interviews and screenings. Marketed, evaluated and bid development projects. Assessed viability and marketability of emerging technologies. Responsible for providing development services on major contracts.

-Lead PL/SQL developer and Oracle database analyst assisting Parsons Engineering on the first nationally all digital hydrographic survey for the State of New Mexico.

-Visual Basic/C++ developer and SQL Server database analyst for ground up development of computer aided dispatch system for national commercial emergency 911 software manufacturer and distributer. Utilized emerging Windows 2000 development technologies: COM+, MTS, DCOM, MSMQ, and XML.

-Designed, engineered and developed a geographic linear address based spatial interface into the existing Computer Aided Dispatch e911 system allowing for spatial display of and interaction with unit and incident locations.

positions.title: CTO/Principal Partner
positions.description:
•	Design, development and implementation of custom products and their augmentation of and integration with existing third-party products. 
•	Hardware and software needs assessments
•	Project evaluation and price assessments.
•	Prototype project design and implementation. 
•	Design and administration of in-house multi-platform network, web server and other associated systems.
•	Hardware specification, configuration and peripheral installation.
•	Service and maintenance of third-party products.
•	End user documentation and training.
•	On-site system/database consulting, design, installation, configuration and emergency recovery.
•	Manage and participate in ESRI business partner relationship.

positions.title: Senior GIS Developer
positions.description:
Designed and implemented large scale utility infrastructure GIS applications for distributed user bases across muti-tier management levels. Responsible for systems integration, project management, application development, implementation and maintenance. Directly in charge of agency wide on-site technical support, application delivery, client interaction and training. 

-Lead developer of GIS application development team.
-Ground up design, integration and implementation of enterprise spatial application.
-Maintained direct relationships with key national and international clients.

positions.title: Senior GIS Analyst/Lab Technician
positions.description: Managed and assisted in the utilization and implementation of GIS projects. Responsibilities included: geodesy, photogrammetry, geographic and tabular databases design; Standards definition for the conversion and manipulation of pre-existing analog and digital geographic information and  relational data; GIS application design and software development. Included providing lab teaching assistance in traditional geographic disciplines and their technological applications using GIS.
